LanguageData.RS_EnhancedAssaultDescription: Raiders carry and recover limited ladder kits. Eligible concentrated raids may deploy a fortified artillery camp, while sappers favor demolition troops. Existing entrances and shared routes remain in use.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Ordinary: This raiding party has artillery support. Its gun crews will deploy independently while the main force follows its original tactics.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Breaching: This breaching force has artillery support. Its gun crews will deploy independently while the main force advances to breach your defenses.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Mechanoid: This mechanoid force has automated turret support. Hostile constructoids will deploy the battery independently while the main force follows its original tactics.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Siege: This siege force has stronger artillery than an ordinary raid. They will establish a fortified gun position and sustain a bombardment of your defenders and fortifications in preparation for a breakthrough.
